newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Comercial del Plata sells $330 mln stakes.
newsitem.headline: Comercial del Plata sells $330 mln stakes.

text.p: Argentine holding company Comercial Del Plata said Friday it expected to raise up to $330 million from three deals to sell interests in half a dozen Argentine companies.
The deals include the sale of petrol businesses to Astra, a subsidiary of Spain's Repsol, and of interests in construction and energy firms.

Comercial del Plata said in a statement that it expected "significant capital gains" -- not detailed -- from the sale to Astra of its stakes in petrol businesses EG3, Refineria San Lorenzo (Refisan), Destilerias Argentina de Petroleo (Dapsa) and Parafinas del Plata.
It also announced the sale of its 15 percent stake in Citelec SA, which controls electricity firm Transener SA, to Maipu Inversora SA, which belongs to the conglomerate Perez Companc.

Furthermore, it said it was "in advanced negotiations to agree a strategic association with an international construction company" which involved the sale of 50 percent of its construction firm CPC SA.

Comercial del Plata said these sales were part of its aim to "obtain liquid funds to strengthen and expand regionally its central businesses in petrol -- upstream and downstream -- natural gas, entertainment, water and sewage, agrochemicals and engineering and construction."
